meta.title: QFooD — Scan. Order. Pay.
meta.description: QFooD turns every restaurant table into a self-checkout. Guests scan a QR code to browse the menu, order, split the bill and pay with Apple Pay or Google Pay — no app, no waiting.

hero.subtitle: Your guests scan a QR code at the table, browse the menu, order and pay in seconds — no app download, no waiting for a waiter. Built for restaurants in Georgia and Central Asia.

how.title: Order in three taps
how.subtitle: No installs, no sign-ups, no friction. From seated to served in under a minute.
how.step1Desc: Each table has its own QR code. Guests scan with their phone camera and the menu opens instantly in the browser.
how.step2Desc: Photos, descriptions and prices in the guest's language. Add items to the cart and send the order straight to the kitchen.
how.step3Desc: Split the bill with the table and pay with Apple Pay, Google Pay or card — all without flagging down a waiter.

features.title: Everything your restaurant needs
features.subtitle: One platform for guests, staff and owners — from the first scan to the closing report.
features.splitBillDesc: Made for group dining. Guests divide the bill evenly or by item and each pays their own share in seconds.
features.payDesc: Tap-to-pay checkout with cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Fast, secure and fully contactless.
features.noAppDesc: Everything runs in the mobile browser. Guests just scan and go — nothing to install or sign up for.
features.kitchenDesc: Orders arrive on a tablet in real time. Staff log in with a simple PIN and update order status as it cooks.
features.ownerDesc: Manage menus, tables and pricing, and track sales and analytics from a single admin panel.
features.multiDesc: Serve every guest in their language — Georgian, English and Russian out of the box.

pricing.title: Simple, honest pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade only when QFooD is working for you.
pricing.afterTrial: after your free month — cancel anytime

footer.tagline: Scan. Order. Pay. QR ordering and payments for modern restaurants.
